dbPath.description: Absolute path of the SQLite database file to open. Ignored when the core is already initialized (the first path wins).

initialized.description: True when this call opened the database; false when a previous call (or the desktop Tauri setup hook) had already initialized the core.

failures.description: Consecutive failures so far (reset to 0 on success).

invalidated.description: True once an auth rejection made retrying pointless until re-pairing.

holdUntil.description: Timestamp (ms) until which auto-sync should hold off.
